[[Bylsma]] was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]], who was in command of a [[Dibrook Space Station|space station]] in orbit of [[Dibrook]] that housed refugees early in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. The station came [[Battle of Dibrook|under attack]] by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] forces, and had its shields stripped away. Bylsma ordered the station's fighter wing to launch, and told them to use their superior numbers to wipe out the attackers quickly because of the lack of shields. However, when a [[Heart of Artorias|larger vessel]] approached, he ordered a retreat. When the ship fired on the Yuuzhan Vong, Bylsma ordered the fighters to focus on the smaller ships. After the battle, he told [[Kaye Galfridian]] that one of the Vong ships had fled to Dibrook's uninhabitable surface, and she decided to follow. He gave her and her crew vac suits and weapons, and also sent down a large force of [[New Republic soldier/Legends|New Republic troopers]] under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ogden (captain)|Ogden]], who protested the [[Rescue Mission to Dibrook|mission]].

==Behind the scenes==
Bylsma is identified as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] for most of his appearance in [[Invasion: Rescues 1|''Invasion: Rescues'' 1]], but is referred to as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] by Kaye Galfridian.
